Name: The Living Valley - SVE Compatibility Patch
Author: mariachaaan
Description:
[b][color=#93c47d]The Living Valley: SVE Compatibility Patch[/color][/b] is the essential link for players who want a truly unified experience between the dynamic systems of [b]The Living Valley[/b] and the massive content expansion of [b]Stardew Valley Expanded[/b].

[youtube]HOQAFS_OSy0[/youtube]

⚙️ [b]Requirements[/b]
[list]
[*][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/42597]The Living Valley[/url][/b] (Base Mod)
[*][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url]﻿[/b]
[*][b]SMAPI 4.0+[/b]
[*][b][url=https://player2.game/]Player2 Connection[/url][/b]
[b]﻿[/b][/list]📦 [b]Installation[/b][list=1]
[*]Ensure [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/42597]The Living Valley[/url]﻿[/b] and [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]SVE[/url]﻿[/b] are already installed and working.
[*]Download this compatibility patch.
[*]Extract the contents into your [color=#93c47d]Stardew Valley/Mods[/color] folder.
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI and enjoy a fully integrated living world!

[/list]
